question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Stoic
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Stoic"** means someone who endures pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining. (संयमी)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite the severe pain, he remained **stoic** and didn't let anyone see his discomfort.
 
 
 
• **"Fervent"** refers to having or displaying a passionate intensity. (उत्साही)
 
 
• **Example:** She was a **fervent** supporter of the new policy, advocating for it passionately.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Stoic'** is **'Fervent'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tolerant** (सहिष्णु): Willing to accept or tolerate others' beliefs or actions.

 
 
• **Example:** He is very** tolerant **of different opinions and always listens carefully.
 
 
 
• **Apathetic** (उदासीन): Showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern.
 
 
• **Example:** The students were surprisingly** apathetic** about the upcoming election.
 
 
 
• **Cooperative** (सहयोगी): Willing to work together or assist others.
 
 
• **Example:** The project was completed quickly because everyone was very** cooperative.**
